currentParagraphText: “See, in this instance, it’s rather lucky that there are so many eyes on the Milky Way Galaxy. If we left them behind, there would be many enemies who would use it against the Church, while should we invest a lot to evacuate everyone properly, it will look incredibly good and show everyone how much we care about every member,” the Augur answered, a bit self-deprecatingly. “Besides, the move won’t even be that far.”
